title: Self-Fourier coefficient of a Walsh character
statement:
For every subset $S \subseteq [n]$, the Fourier coefficient of the Walsh character $\chi_S$ at the same set $S$ equals $1$; that is,
\[
  \widehat{\chi_S}(S) = \langle \chi_S, \chi_S \rangle = 1.
\]
hypotheses_covered: S is a subset of [n] (arbitrary, no further constraint)
